agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
December 3, 2025, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
Inglewood, California 90301

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute approval for November 5, 2025, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  CONSENT ITEMS:
  a. A six-month time limit extension for the construction of an
  eight-story mixed-use building consisting of 150 residential units,
  commercial/retail space and associated parking on an approximately
  41,000 square-foot H-C (Historic Core) zoned property.

  Recommendation:
  Consider the staff report, any testimony and make a determination.
  It is recommended that you:
  1) Approve the six-month extension for DR24-00058 and
  Resolution No. 2008 dated November 6, 2024; or
  2) Deny the six-month extension for DR24-00058.
  Item 6a Documents

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Raul Cueva, Jr,
  representing IHOP, for Special Use Permit No. 25-00020(SUP25-00020)
  to allow the sale of distilled spirits for on-site consumption
  within an existing restaurant on a C-2A/R-3 zoned property at 4410
  West Century Boulevard.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-128) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is available
  for public review in the Planning Division office of City Hall and
  via email request to faith.smith@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-128;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP25-00020.
  B. If the Planning Commision determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents

8.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Kenrick
  Sanderlin, representing the City of Inglewood, for Siminski Park
  Improvement Project.
   A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-135) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is available
  for public review in the Planning Division office of City Hall and
  via email request to bespinoza@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2025-135;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving PCR25-00012.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 8a Documents

9.  Public Comments:
  Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission on any matter
  within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere considered on the
  agenda may do so at this time.

10.  Commission Initiatives.

11.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of December 3, 2025,
is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda
item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda
item will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning
Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 4, 2026, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
